snippet.title: Shrooms! Tower Defence - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Cute, squishy, and armed to the gills — your Shroom defenders are the forest’s last hope against lumberjack invasion! Grow, evolve, and command your Shrooms to protect your unique island home in this 3D roguelite tower defence game.

Available 27th November on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310170/Shrooms_Tower_Defence/
